---
title: "Pathview"
description: "Enrich KO identifiers and map quantitative log fold changes onto native KEGG pathway diagrams."
---

## Required files

The current Pathview module uses two CSV files.

### `pathview.csv`

Two columns:

```text
KO,logFC
K00844,1.25
K01810,-0.83
```

KO identifiers are normalized to the `Kxxxxx` format.

### `pathway_file.csv`

Three columns:

```text
pathway,ko,Description
map00010,K00844,Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis
```

## GUI workflow

1. Upload the KO/logFC file.
2. Upload the pathway-to-KO annotation file.
3. Choose **Plant, Animals, Bacteria, Fungi, Eukaryotes, or Hsa**.
4. Click **Run KEGG Enrichment**.
5. Select an enriched pathway.
6. Click **Draw Selected Pathway**.

ProtVis filters to valid KO identifiers, performs enrichment, then calls `pathview` with `species = "ko"` and native KEGG output. Multiple KO values mapping to the same node are summarized by the mean.

## Output

The native KEGG pathway is written as a PNG in the current working directory and shown in the interface together with a KO/logFC preview.

::: {.callout-note}
## Internet access may be required
Pathview can require access to KEGG resources while generating the native pathway map. If enrichment succeeds but no PNG is generated, verify the KO IDs, selected pathway and network access.
:::
